fit: Middle half of each segment; endpoint quarters are conditional checks. Camera itself was fitted to calibration track candidates, and selection used all frames.
camera_status: Experimental camera only, not accepted calibration
coordinates: Projection maps nuisance world coordinates to 512-high centered/padded image pixels. Orientation rows are image-right, image-up, and their cross product. No metric camera location or depth translation is identified.
world_convention: Z-up orbit-axis gauge; yaw0 near negativeY viewing direction with fitted elevation/roll. Scale256px/world-unit is a relative gauge, not metric calibration. Exact per-frame projection matrices retained separately.
